018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.time.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.function.*;

030/**
031 * What a {@link ServerBus} will carry, in which direction, to whom.  Everything not allowed here is denied.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Downstream entries are topic patterns: a custom topic ({@code ns.name}), a keyed custom topic or key pattern
035 * ({@code ns.name:key}, {@code ns.name:*}), a job topic or pattern ({@code job:<id>}, {@code job:*}), or a card command
036 * topic ({@code cmd:<cardId>}).  Upstream entries are exact custom topics, each with its {@link UpstreamHandler}.
037 *
038 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
039 * <p class='bjava'>
040 *   BusPolicy <jv>p</jv> = BusPolicy.<jsm>create</jsm>()
041 *     .downstream(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>, <jk>true</jk>)                       <jc>// retained state</jc>
042 *     .downstream(<js>"ops.alert:*"</js>, <jk>false</jk>)                  <jc>// events, any key</jc>
043 *     .upstream(<js>"ops.cancel-all"</js>, (<jv>session</jv>, <jv>topic</jv>, <jv>payload</jv>) -&gt; <jv>jobs</jv>.cancelAll())
044 *     .authorizer((<jv>req</jv>, <jv>topic</jv>) -&gt; <jv>req</jv>.isUserInRole(<js>"ops"</js>))  <jc>// per-user, both directions</jc>
045 *     .boundary(<jv>boundary</jv>)                                           <jc>// LoopbackBoundary or CsrfBoundary</jc>
046 *     .build();
047 *
048 *   <jc>// In a page test: every topic the page's bridges request is granted (E-55 otherwise).</jc>
049 *   <jv>p</jv>.check(PageCapture.<jsm>of</jsm>(<jv>html</jv>).contract());
050 * </p>
051 *
052 * @since 10.0.0
053 */
054public final class BusPolicy {
055
056   static final String CUSTOM = "[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}\\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}";
057   static final String KEY = "[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}";
058   static final String CARD_ID = "[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}";
059
060   /** Valid downstream topic patterns. */
061   static final Pattern DOWNSTREAM_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
062      "^(" + CUSTOM + "(:(" + KEY + "|\\*))?|job:(" + KEY + "|\\*)|cmd:" + CARD_ID + ")$");
063
064   /** Valid upstream topics: exact custom topics only. */
065   static final Pattern UPSTREAM_TOPIC = Pattern.compile("^" + CUSTOM + "(:" + KEY + ")?$");
066
067   /** The C1 id pattern, used for bridge ids. */
068   static final Pattern BRIDGE_ID = Pattern.compile("^" + CARD_ID + "$");
069
070   private final Map<String,Boolean> downstream;
071   private final Map<String,UpstreamHandler> upstream;
072   private final BiPredicate<HttpServletRequest,String> authorizer;
073   private final RequestBoundary boundary;
074   private final List<String> allowedOrigins;
075   private final Duration sessionGrace;
076   private final Duration maxSessionAge;
077   private final Duration heartbeat;
078   private final int maxSessions;
079   private final int maxQueuedFrames;
080   private final int maxFrameBytes;
081   private final int maxUpstreamPerSecond;
082   private final Function<HttpServletRequest,Map<String,Object>> sessionAttributes;
083
084   private BusPolicy(Builder b) {
085      downstream = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(b.downstream));
086      upstream = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(b.upstream));
087      authorizer = b.authorizer;
088      boundary = b.boundary;
089      allowedOrigins = b.allowedOrigins;
090      sessionGrace = b.sessionGrace;
091      maxSessionAge = b.maxSessionAge;
092      heartbeat = b.heartbeat;
093      maxSessions = b.maxSessions;
094      maxQueuedFrames = b.maxQueuedFrames;
095      maxFrameBytes = b.maxFrameBytes;
096      maxUpstreamPerSecond = b.maxUpstreamPerSecond;
097      sessionAttributes = b.sessionAttributes;
098   }
099
100   /**
101    * Creates a new builder.  An unmodified builder builds a policy that grants nothing.
102    *
103    * @return A new builder.
104    */
105   public static Builder create() {
106      return new Builder();
107   }
108
109   /**
110    * Returns whether a topic (or a requested pattern) may flow downstream, and if so whether it is retained.
111    *
112    * <p>
113    * A policy entry covers a topic when it is equal to it, or when the entry is {@code family:*} and the topic is
114    * {@code family:<anything>}.
115    *
116    * @param topic A concrete topic or a requested pattern.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
117    * @return The retain flag, or empty when the topic is denied.
118    */
119   public Optional<Boolean> downstreamRetain(String topic) {
120      if (topic == null || ! DOWNSTREAM_PATTERN.matcher(topic).matches())
121         return Optional.empty();
122      var exact = downstream.get(topic);
123      if (exact != null)
124         return Optional.of(exact);
125      var i = topic.indexOf(':');
126      if (i > 0) {
127         var wild = downstream.get(topic.substring(0, i) + ":*");
128         if (wild != null)
129            return Optional.of(wild);
130      }
131      return Optional.empty();
132   }
133
134   /**
135    * Returns whether a topic may flow upstream (exact match only).
136    *
137    * @param topic The topic.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
138    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the policy has a handler for it.
139    */
140   public boolean allowsUpstream(String topic) {
141      return topic != null && upstream.containsKey(topic);
142   }
143
144   UpstreamHandler upstreamHandler(String topic) {
145      return upstream.get(topic);
146   }
147
148   /**
149    * Checks that this policy grants every topic that a page contract's {@code bridges} request (E-55).
150    *
151    * <p>
152    * Adopter page tests call this next to {@code PageContractAssert.hasNoWiringErrors()}.  The request-dependent
153    * {@link #authorizer()} is not consulted: it can only narrow a grant at session time.
154    *
155    * @param contract The page contract (for example {@code PageCapture.of(html).contract()}).
156    * @throws IllegalStateException Listing every denied topic, one {@code E-55} line each.
157    */
158   @SuppressWarnings({
159      "java:S3776" // Walking the bridge contract is inherently nested.
160   })
161   public void check(Map<String,?> contract) {
162      var problems = new ArrayList<String>();
163      if (contract != null && contract.get("bridges") instanceof Collection<?> bridges) {
164         for (var raw : bridges) {
165            if (! (raw instanceof Map<?,?> bridge))
166               continue;
167            var id = String.valueOf(bridge.get("id"));
168            for (var t : strings(bridge.get("downstream")))
169               if (downstreamRetain(t).isEmpty())
170                  problems.add(e55("downstream", t, id));
171            for (var t : strings(bridge.get("upstream")))
172               if (! allowsUpstream(t))
173                  problems.add(e55("upstream", t, id));
174         }
175      }
176      if (! problems.isEmpty())
177         throw new IllegalStateException(String.join("\n", problems));
178   }
179
180   private static String e55(String direction, String topic, String bridge) {
181      return "E-55: " + f("BusPolicy denies %s topic '%s' that bridge '%s' requests", direction, topic, bridge);
182   }
183
184   private static List<String> strings(Object o) {
185      return o instanceof Collection<?> c ? c.stream().map(String::valueOf).toList() : List.of();
186   }
187
188   /** @return The per-request, per-topic authorizer applied at session open.  Defaults to allow-all. */
189   public BiPredicate<HttpServletRequest,String> authorizer() { return authorizer; }
190
191   /** @return The request boundary, or <jk>null</jk> when the application has its own guard. */
192   public RequestBoundary boundary() { return boundary; }
193
194   /** @return The exact origins allowed on a WebSocket handshake when no {@link #boundary()} is set. */
195   public List<String> allowedOrigins() { return allowedOrigins; }
196
197   /** @return How long a session survives after its last connection closes.  Default 60 s. */
198   public Duration sessionGrace() { return sessionGrace; }
199
200   /** @return The absolute session lifetime.  Default 12 h. */
201   public Duration maxSessionAge() { return maxSessionAge; }
202
203   /** @return The idle interval after which a {@code ping} frame is sent.  Default 15 s. */
204   public Duration heartbeat() { return heartbeat; }
205
206   /** @return The maximum number of live sessions.  Default 256. */
207   public int maxSessions() { return maxSessions; }
208
209   /** @return The per-connection outbound queue bound.  Default 1024. */
210   public int maxQueuedFrames() { return maxQueuedFrames; }
211
212   /** @return The maximum encoded frame size in UTF-8 bytes, both directions.  Default 65536. */
213   public int maxFrameBytes() { return maxFrameBytes; }
214
215   /** @return The per-session upstream frame rate limit.  Default 20. */
216   public int maxUpstreamPerSecond() { return maxUpstreamPerSecond; }
217
218   /** @return The function that captures session attributes at session open.  Defaults to an empty map. */
219   public Function<HttpServletRequest,Map<String,Object>> sessionAttributes() { return sessionAttributes; }
220
221   /**
222    * Builder for {@link BusPolicy}.
223    *
224    * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
225    * <p class='bjava'>
226    *   BusPolicy <jv>p</jv> = BusPolicy.<jsm>create</jsm>()
227    *     .downstream(<js>"ops.jobs"</js>, <jk>true</jk>)
228    *     .sessionAttributes(<jv>req</jv> -&gt; Map.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"region"</js>, <jv>req</jv>.getHeader(<js>"X-Region"</js>)))
229    *     .maxSessions(64)
230    *     .build();
231    * </p>
232    */
233   public static final class Builder {
234
235      final Map<String,Boolean> downstream = new LinkedHashMap<>();
236      final Map<String,UpstreamHandler> upstream = new LinkedHashMap<>();
237      BiPredicate<HttpServletRequest,String> authorizer = (req, topic) -> true;
238      RequestBoundary boundary;
239      List<String> allowedOrigins = List.of();
240      Duration sessionGrace = Duration.ofSeconds(60);
241      Duration maxSessionAge = Duration.ofHours(12);
242      Duration heartbeat = Duration.ofSeconds(15);
243      int maxSessions = 256;
244      int maxQueuedFrames = 1024;
245      int maxFrameBytes = 65536;
246      int maxUpstreamPerSecond = 20;
247      Function<HttpServletRequest,Map<String,Object>> sessionAttributes = req -> Map.of();
248
249      Builder() {}
250
251      /**
252       * Allows a topic pattern downstream (server → page).
253       *
254       * @param topicPattern {@code ns.name}, {@code ns.name:key}, {@code ns.name:*}, {@code job:<id>}, {@code job:*} or {@code cmd:<cardId>}.
255       * @param retain Whether values are retained and resent on every (re)connect.
256       * @return This object.
257       * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-57 on an invalid or repeated pattern.
258       */
259      public Builder downstream(String topicPattern, boolean retain) {
260         if (topicPattern == null || ! DOWNSTREAM_PATTERN.matcher(topicPattern).matches())
261            throw e57("BusPolicy: '%s' is not a valid topic pattern", topicPattern);
262         if (downstream.putIfAbsent(topicPattern, retain) != null)
263            throw e57("BusPolicy: '%s' is declared twice", topicPattern);
264         return this;
265      }
266
267      /**
268       * Allows an exact custom topic upstream (page → server, WebSocket only) and names its handler.
269       *
270       * @param topic The topic ({@code ns.name} or {@code ns.name:key}).
271       * @param handler The handler.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
272       * @return This object.
273       * @throws IllegalArgumentException E-57 on an invalid or repeated topic, or a <jk>null</jk> handler.
274       */
275      public Builder upstream(String topic, UpstreamHandler handler) {
276         if (topic == null || ! UPSTREAM_TOPIC.matcher(topic).matches())
277            throw e57("BusPolicy: '%s' is not a valid topic pattern", topic);
278         if (handler == null)
279            throw e57("BusPolicy: upstream topic '%s' has no handler", topic);
280         if (upstream.putIfAbsent(topic, handler) != null)
281            throw e57("BusPolicy: '%s' is declared twice", topic);
282         return this;
283      }
284
285      /**
286       * Sets a per-request, per-topic authorizer, consulted for every requested topic at session open.
287       *
288       * @param value The authorizer.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
289       * @return This object.
290       */
291      public Builder authorizer(BiPredicate<HttpServletRequest,String> value) {
292         authorizer = Objects.requireNonNull(value, "authorizer");
293         return this;
294      }
295
296      /**
297       * Sets the request boundary.  The session POST and SSE stream apply its {@code check}.
298       *
299       * <p>
300       * The WebSocket handshake cannot run {@code check}, so it applies the boundary's own handshake rules: a
301       * {@link LoopbackBoundary}'s exact {@code origin()} and {@code authority()}, or a {@link CsrfBoundary}'s
302       * {@code Origin} match against the handshake's own {@code Host} and scheme.  {@code BusWebSockets.register}
303       * refuses any other boundary type.
304       *
305       * @param value The boundary.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
306       * @return This object.
307       */
308      public Builder boundary(RequestBoundary value) {
309         boundary = value;
310         return this;
311      }
312
313      /**
314       * Sets the exact origins a WebSocket handshake may carry when no boundary is set.  Ignored when a boundary is set.
315       *
316       * @param values Origins such as {@code https://console.example.org}.  None may be blank.
317       * @return This object.
318       */
319      public Builder allowedOrigins(String...values) {
320         for (var v : Objects.requireNonNull(values, "allowedOrigins"))
321            if (ib(v))
322               throw new IllegalArgumentException("BusPolicy: allowedOrigins entries must not be blank");
323         allowedOrigins = List.of(values);
324         return this;
325      }
326
327      /** @param value Grace after the last connection closes.  Default 60 s. @return This object. */
328      public Builder sessionGrace(Duration value) { sessionGrace = positive("sessionGrace", value); return this; }
329
330      /** @param value Absolute session lifetime.  Default 12 h. @return This object. */
331      public Builder maxSessionAge(Duration value) { maxSessionAge = positive("maxSessionAge", value); return this; }
332
333      /** @param value Idle interval before a {@code ping} frame.  Default 15 s. @return This object. */
334      public Builder heartbeat(Duration value) { heartbeat = positive("heartbeat", value); return this; }
335
336      /** @param value Maximum live sessions.  Default 256. @return This object. */
337      public Builder maxSessions(int value) { maxSessions = positive("maxSessions", value); return this; }
338
339      /** @param value Per-connection outbound queue bound.  Default 1024. @return This object. */
340      public Builder maxQueuedFrames(int value) { maxQueuedFrames = positive("maxQueuedFrames", value); return this; }
341
342      /** @param value Maximum encoded frame size, UTF-8 bytes.  Default 65536. @return This object. */
343      public Builder maxFrameBytes(int value) { maxFrameBytes = positive("maxFrameBytes", value); return this; }
344
345      /** @param value Per-session upstream frames per second.  Default 20. @return This object. */
346      public Builder maxUpstreamPerSecond(int value) { maxUpstreamPerSecond = positive("maxUpstreamPerSecond", value); return this; }
347
348      /**
349       * Sets the function that captures attributes onto each {@link BusSession} at session open.
350       *
351       * @param value The function.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>; it may return <jk>null</jk> for "none".
352       * @return This object.
353       */
354      public Builder sessionAttributes(Function<HttpServletRequest,Map<String,Object>> value) {
355         sessionAttributes = Objects.requireNonNull(value, "sessionAttributes");
356         return this;
357      }
358
359      /**
360       * Builds the policy.
361       *
362       * @return A new immutable policy.
363       */
364      public BusPolicy build() {
365         return new BusPolicy(this);
366      }
367
368      private static Duration positive(String name, Duration v) {
369         if (v == null || v.isZero() || v.isNegative())
370            throw new IllegalArgumentException(f("BusPolicy: %s must be positive", name));
371         return v;
372      }
373
374      private static int positive(String name, int v) {
375         if (v <= 0)
376            throw new IllegalArgumentException(f("BusPolicy: %s must be positive", name));
377         return v;
378      }
379
380      private static IllegalArgumentException e57(String format, Object...args) {
381         return new IllegalArgumentException("E-57: " + f(format, args));
382      }
383   }
384}
